# Theme Radar

> Thematic equity research and the baskets that track it. Free and open. Market data to the 2026-11-09 close.

Research pieces are written as theses with named tickers, dated numbers and sources. Each idea is tracked as a basket from its start date.

## Research
- [AI infrastructure, the next 12 months: re-evaluating the AI hardware basket](https://theme-radar.github.io/research/ai-infrastructure-next-12-months.md): 2026-11-06. Theme: AI Hardware. NVDA, AMD, TSM, COHR, LITE, BE. The midterms raised the odds of a slower, more constrained US data-center build-out. AI demand stays strong, so the call is selective growth: prefer TSM and AMD, do not add to NVDA, sell LITE, keep COHR small, and hold BE.
- [CAT Initiation: Power Story or Cycle Stock?](https://theme-radar.github.io/research/cat-initiation-power-or-cycle.md): 2026-11-06. Theme: Single stock. CAT, GEV, CMI, DE. Accumulate on weakness with one entry price, about $460: what CAT is worth if the data-center slowdown happens (2027 EPS of $28.99 at 16x). The 2026 sell-off was a multiple reset, not an earnings miss, and the power backlog is sold out into 2029-30. $460 does not protect against a construction downturn on top (bear case $340).
- [Earnings update Q3 2026: Amazon, Meta, Shopify](https://theme-radar.github.io/research/agentic-commerce-q3-2026-earnings.md): 2026-11-04. Theme: Agentic Commerce. AMZN, META, SHOP, V. Amazon is open to outside agents on its own terms, Meta's Muse works but the bill arrived as negative free cash flow and a $95bn raise, and Shopify's rail held while the stock fell. Visa says agent volume is still too small to matter in 2027.
- [Binance heist: what it means for our cyber basket](https://theme-radar.github.io/research/binance-heist-cyber-basket.md): 2026-11-04. Theme: Cybersecurity. PANW, SAIL, FROG, CRWD, DDOG, NET. The largest crypto theft on record ran through a poisoned package, a fake job offer, an over-privileged token and an internal AI tool. No change to the basket, but it points to identity and software supply chain. A fear-driven slowdown in AI agents helps the basket. A return-driven one is the real risk.
- [Channel check: what a Nobel Prize-winning mRNA lab at Penn told us about AI, monkeys and the wet lab](https://theme-radar.github.io/research/penn-mrna-channel-check.md): 2026-11-04. Theme: AI Science. CRL, 2395.T, ICLR, TWST, DHR, TMO, TECN, WAT, A, BRKR, RVTY, DNA, GENB, RXRX, CERT, NTRA, TEM. A Penn mRNA scientist confirmed that monkeys, wet-lab capacity and labour are the scarce inputs in drug discovery, and flagged two risks: AI still needs heavy human checking, and China is now the cheapest source of lab kit.
- [Cybersecurity hardware: Fortinet and F5](https://theme-radar.github.io/research/cyber-hardware-ftnt-ffiv.md): 2026-11-02. Theme: Cybersecurity. FTNT, FFIV. Both names fell about 20% on earnings in the same week. The moat is being physically in the data path inside the customer's building, which AI cannot vibe-code. Own the category at equal weight, but wait: the entry conditions and kill triggers are set out name by name.
- [If frontier AI labs are becoming the next generation of biotech platforms, how should we position?](https://theme-radar.github.io/research/ai-frontier-labs-biotech.md): 2026-10-31. Theme: AI Science. TWST, OABI, DHR, WAT, RVTY, TXG, ILMN, TMO, A, ICLR, CRL, 2395.T, GENB, LLY, NTRA, TEM. Frontier AI labs are buying biotechs, building wet labs and starting their own drug programmes. Design gets cheap and validation stays scarce, so the physical layer gets paid: molecule makers, lab tools, testing services and data owners.
- [Update on the cybersecurity basket: six new names](https://theme-radar.github.io/research/cyber-basket-update-oct26.md): 2026-10-26. Theme: Cybersecurity. MSFT, FROG, QLYS, ACN, CACI, MITK. Five weeks in, the nine-name basket is up 11.4% against 6.0% for IGV. We map security spend into eight layers, ask where AI agents push growth fastest, and add six names: MSFT, FROG, QLYS, ACN, CACI and MITK.
- [The Mall Is Closing: Shopify, Meta's Muse and the Agentic Storefront](https://theme-radar.github.io/research/the-mall-is-closing.md): 2026-10-14. Theme: Agentic Commerce. SHOP, META, AMZN. When AI agents do the shopping, the rails get paid every time (Shopify), the assistant that knows the buyer earns a commission (Meta), and the everything store has to reinvent itself or shrink (Amazon).
- [Passport Control for Robots: SAIL vs OKTA](https://theme-radar.github.io/research/passport-control-for-robots.md): 2026-10-09. Theme: Cybersecurity. SAIL, OKTA. AI agents pay the identity registry, not the login. Governance is priced per identity, login per employee. Within listed identity, SailPoint owns the better-placed layer at the lower multiple.
- [AI agentic beneficiaries: cybersecurity theme primer and shopping list](https://theme-radar.github.io/research/cybersecurity-theme-primer.md): 2026-09-18. Theme: Cybersecurity. ZS, FFIV, RBRK, FTNT, NET, PANW, CRWD, SAIL. Who gets paid when software starts doing the work: the traffic, the control points and the record-keeping that every AI agent has to pass through. A shopping list, built before the down day we cannot time.
- [The USD Debasement Basket: initiation report](https://theme-radar.github.io/research/usd-debasement-initiation.md): 2026-05-20. Theme: US Dollar Devaluation. FNV, WPM, AEM, ALS. Gold royalty and streaming companies are the hedge we need for the financial repression era. Basket: FNV, WPM, AEM and ALS.

## Themes
- [Cybersecurity](https://theme-radar.github.io/themes/cybersecurity.md): How AI agents change security spending, and which layers get paid.
- [AI Science](https://theme-radar.github.io/themes/ai-science.md): AI-driven scientific discovery, and the tools, labs and data it runs on.
- [Agentic Commerce](https://theme-radar.github.io/themes/agentic-commerce.md): Agentic shopping, e-commerce, payments and the financial rails underneath.
- [US Dollar Devaluation](https://theme-radar.github.io/themes/us-dollar-devaluation.md): Gold equities as a hedge against a weaker dollar.
- [AI Hardware](https://theme-radar.github.io/themes/ai-hardware.md): The AI build-out in silicon, optics, memory, equipment and power, and how it gets financed.

- [Stock index](https://theme-radar.github.io/stocks.md): every ticker named in the research, each with its own page at /stocks/TICKER/

## Thematic Baskets (equal weight, buy-and-hold)
- [Cyber Security](https://theme-radar.github.io/baskets/cyber-security.md): from 2026-09-18, +0.4% since start, label No signal. Fifteen names across the security platforms and services that AI agents depend on: endpoint, network, zero trust, identity, software supply chain, data, observability and recovery.
- [AI Science](https://theme-radar.github.io/baskets/ai-science.md): from 2026-08-17, +17.4% since start, label Already moving. Frontier AI labs are becoming biotech platforms, so the physical layer gets paid: molecule makers, lab tools, testing services, AI drug developers and pharma. 14 names, equal weight. SNBL (2395.T) is priced in yen.
- [US Dollar Devaluation](https://theme-radar.github.io/baskets/usd-devaluation.md): from 2026-05-20, +12.4% since start, label Already moving. Gold royalty, streaming and mining names as a hedge against a weaker dollar. ALS is priced in Canadian dollars (TSX).
- [Agentic Commerce](https://theme-radar.github.io/baskets/agentic-commerce.md): from 2026-10-14, +2.8% since start, label No signal. AI agents shopping and checking out for people. Three layers: the agents (META, AMZN, GOOGL, AAPL), checkout and payment rails (SHOP, V, MA, PYPL, ADYEN, AFRM, GLBE) and retailers open to agents (WMT, CART, BBY). 14 names, equal weight. ADYEN is priced in euros (Amsterdam).
- [AI Hardware](https://theme-radar.github.io/baskets/ai-hardware.md): from 2026-07-31, -17.0% since start, label No signal. The chips, optics, memory and equipment behind the AI build-out, plus the hyperscalers that buy them and the power and cooling that keep them running. 19 names, equal weight. IFX is priced in euros (Xetra).
